fato_historico: 1993: The flood of '93 ends at St. Louis, Missouri, 103 days after it began, as the Mississippi River falls below flood stage.
energia_do_dia: Just as the mighty river finally settles back into its natural banks after a long season of turbulence, today you may find your restless mind returning to a place of peaceful clarity. It is a good time to release emotional overflows and let your thoughts find their steady, graceful channel once again, allowing your dual nature to harmonize beautifully.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest currents eventually find their way back to a gentle, steady path.
significado_numero: Represents the stabilization of fluctuating energies and the wisdom of patience.
conselho: Consider letting go of old worries and trust that the tide has finally turned.
